stories.title: Rival Watch — Brewers Lead NLDS 2-1, Game 4 Tonight in San Diego
stories.angle: Padres survived NLDS elimination in Game 3 (4-3). Brewers still lead series 2-1. Game 4 tonight at Petco Park. Cubs fan angle: the team that swept us (Padres) is still alive — if Brewers close it out tonight, that WCS sting fades just a bit.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Padres 4, Brewers 3 last night. Series is 2-1 Brewers. Game 4 tonight in San Diego.

The Padres — who outscored the Cubs 12-1 in the WCS — are still breathing.

If the Brewers close it out tonight, that sweep stings a little less.

#Cubs #MLB #NorthSiders

stories.title: Hoyer's Offseason Reckoning — Pitching Overhaul Priority
stories.angle: Hoyer's end-of-season presser: Cubs led NL with 231 HR allowed, set club record with 14 different save-recorders. Gausman, Imanaga, Boyd, Holmes, Peterson all free agents. Promising aggressive pitching overhaul. Most critical offseason in Hoyer era.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Jed Hoyer is taking accountability — and he should.

231 HR allowed. FOURTEEN different pitchers recorded saves.

Gausman. Imanaga. Boyd. Holmes. Peterson. All gone.

This is the most critical offseason in the Hoyer era. Time to prove it.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: PCA NL MVP — The Vote Is Coming
stories.angle: PCA is -1100 MVP favorite. 45 HR, 40 SB, 10.4 fWAR — 7th 40-40 in MLB history, first Cub ever. Two quiet WCS games don't move the needle. BBWAA votes in November.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong's 2026 season: 45 HR. 40 SB. 10.4 fWAR.

The 7th player in MLB history to go 40-40 — and the FIRST Cub ever.

He's the -1100 favorite to win NL MVP. Two quiet WCS games don't change what happened over 162.

The ballot is already filled out.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Rotation Rebuild Market — Hoyer Must Spend
stories.angle: Cubs need 2-3 SP this winter. Market includes Cease, Valdez, Suárez, Gallen — and Michael King (who nearly no-hit them in WCS G1). Horton and Steele both out until 2027. No choice but to spend.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Cubs need 2-3 starting pitchers this winter — Cease, Valdez, Suárez, Gallen are all available.

Including Michael King. The guy who nearly no-hit them in WCS Game 1.

Horton and Steele won't be back until 2027. Hoyer must spend.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Seiya Suzuki — Will Cubs Win the Bidding War?
stories.angle: Reports say Cubs "unlikely" to win Suzuki bidding war. Toronto interested. Budget stretched by Bregman/PCA/Hoerner deals. Losing Suzuki AND Happ in same winter while Horton rehabs = significant risk. Framed as decision analysis, not transaction.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Reports say the Cubs are "unlikely" to win the Suzuki bidding war. Toronto is circling.

After Bregman, Hoerner, and PCA's deals, the budget is tight.

Losing Happ AND Suzuki in the same winter while Horton rehabs is a real risk.

#Cubs #MLB #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Steele + Horton 2027 — Both Out, But the Upside Is Real
stories.angle: Both Cade Horton (15-month TJ, return July/Aug 2027) and Justin Steele (UCL surgery) are out until 2027. Silver lining: if Hoyer adds 2 arms this winter AND both return healthy, this rotation's ceiling is elite.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Bad news: Horton (15-month TJ) and Steele (UCL) are both out until at least mid-2027.

Good news: add two starters this winter AND get both back healthy, and this rotation's ceiling is elite.

The 2027 upside is REAL.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Ian Happ — 10 Seasons, Now He Earns His Market
stories.angle: Prime evening slot (insights: evening_18_24 WINNER). Ian Happ hits FA for first time at 32. Ten seasons, one team. No extension talks. Bold passionate case for Cubs to bring him home — not nostalgia, his bat still plays.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Ten seasons as a Cub. Never worn another uniform.

Ian Happ hits free agency for the first time at 32. He's earned every dollar of whatever market he finds.

Hoyer has a rotation to rebuild. He can't afford to lose Happ too.

Bring him home.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubNation
